description: Send URLs to AVS Indexer for indexing. THIS SPENDS CREDITS: 1 credit per URL for normal, 10 credits per URL for priority (type "instant"). Before you call this tool, call estimate_cost, tell the user how many URLs will be sent and how many credits it will cost, and wait for the user to say yes. Credits are taken when the URLs are submitted. Dead links (404, noindex and similar) found by the URL check are skipped and refunded automatically. Indexing is not guaranteed: search engines decide which pages they index, and it can take days or weeks. Returns a batch_id. Use get_batch with it to follow progress.

check.description: Check each URL before sending and skip (and refund) dead links. Default true. Only set false if the user asks for it.

drip_days.description: 0 = send all URLs at once. 2 to 30 = spread the URLs evenly over that many days (drip-feed). 1 is not allowed.

project.description: Optional project name to group submissions in the dashboard (max 60 characters).

type.description: "normal" costs 1 credit per URL. "instant" is priority indexing: 10 credits per URL, sent first, for important pages. It does not make indexing instant. Call it "priority" when you talk to the user. Priority needs at least one credit purchase.

urls.description: The URLs to index, each starting with http:// or https://. Up to 5,000. Duplicates and invalid lines are removed and not charged.

name: submit_urls
title: Submit URLs for indexing (spends credits)
